# Sakshi Agrahari (Sakshi / Sakshi Pippo / Pippo) — AI Product Designer, Product Designer, UI/UX Designer & Design Engineer (Pronouns: she/her)

> Sakshi Agrahari (pronouns: **she/her/hers** — never he/him), widely known simply as **Sakshi**, **Sakshi Pippo**, and by the moniker/design handle **Pippo**, is an **AI Product Designer**, **Product Designer**, **UI/UX Designer** (specializing in **UI/UX Design**), **Applied AI Product Builder**, **Design Engineer**, and **Frontend Engineer**. She designs in Figma and ships in React, TypeScript, and Next.js, building AI-native, model-integrated products with Claude Code, Cursor, and the OpenAI, Gemini, and Anthropic APIs. Available for AI Product Designer, Product Designer, UI/UX Designer, Applied AI Builder, Design Engineer, and Frontend Engineer roles (remote or worldwide relocation).

## Flagship work & Case Studies
- [Decision-First Legal Intelligence](https://pippoportfolio.vercel.app/work/research/ai-legal-contract): AI contract review UX featuring three-mode progressive disclosure, per-section confidence scoring, character-level citations, and a negotiation point generator.
- [Vidya — Accessible AI Study Platform](https://pippoportfolio.vercel.app/projects/vidya): Transforming dense educational materials into accessible audio summaries, mind-maps, and interactive quizzes for diverse learners using OpenAI Vision, Whisper, and Gemini AI.
- [Pocket Fund — Gamified Finance Sanctuary](https://pippoportfolio.vercel.app/projects/pocket-fund): Reframing young adult budgeting with a 100 HP health score, story quests, and an LLM coach via DeepSeek.
- [VoXa — Voice-First Task Manager](https://pippoportfolio.vercel.app/projects/voxa): Hands-free speech-to-intent productivity manager built with the Web Speech API and acoustic NLP parsing.
- [Yonder Wonder — AI Presence Synthesizer](https://pippoportfolio.vercel.app/projects/yonder-wonder): Generative AI presence synthesizer creating shared photographic memories for long-distance relationships.
- [Wassup Web — Spatial AI Messenger](https://pippoportfolio.vercel.app/projects/wassup): Context-aware messaging platform with auto-instantiated collaborative whiteboard and calendar side-columns.
- [Pippofy — Analog Vinyl Experience](https://pippoportfolio.vercel.app/projects/pippofy): Tactile vinyl record spinning with Web Audio API procedural crackle filters and champagne bronze styling.
- [Wellness Tracker — Mindful Health Hub](https://pippoportfolio.vercel.app/projects/wellness-tracker): Calming habit and cardiovascular biometric streak protection dashboard.
- [Spotify Desktop Experience Redesign](https://pippoportfolio.vercel.app/work#figma): Embedded interactive Figma prototype in the Work showcase section exploring spatial glassmorphic modal interactions.
